project_name: Marvel Electronics and Home Entertainment E-Store
initial_requirements: Marvel Electronics and Home Entertainment needs an online store to support the sale, distribution, and marketing of electronic products. Customers should be able to browse categorized product information, search the catalogue, and configure products from available components before ordering. The business also needs a way to present detailed product information and manage the customer-facing sales experience through the store.
finish_message: Hashimoto interview completed (turn limit or slot fill rate reached).

messages.content: What are the primary business outcomes Marvel Electronics and Home Entertainment wants this online store to achieve—for example, increased sales, improved product discovery, self-service ordering, or better customer engagement?

The main goal is definitely to increase sales by making it easier for customers to find products and place orders online. We also want better product discovery through browsing and search, and we want customers to be able to configure and order products themselves without needing a lot of manual support. A secondary outcome is to present our products more professionally so the store helps with marketing and customer engagement as well.

Who are the key stakeholders and user groups involved in this online store—such as customers, sales staff, product managers, marketing team members, or administrators—and what responsibilities or needs does each group have?

The main user group is customers, who need to browse, search, compare, configure, and order products easily. Sales staff will likely need access to customer and order information so they can help with inquiries and follow up on sales. Product and marketing teams need to manage product information, promotions, and how products are presented, while administrators would handle overall store setup, access, and day-to-day maintenance.
